selections.rationale: Figure 1 is the only candidate that visibly shows the model’s input routes and architecture interface: the multimodal workflow diagram and MUPAD schematic include image, text, and RNA conditioning into the diffusion/DiT model, with decoupled cross-modal attention and modality-specific inputs. It best matches the paper’s input representations atlas requirement across the listed routes, whereas the other figures are mostly output comparisons or performance plots.
